note: One value switches everything: PROFILE=free or PROFILE=paid (env var, or --profile on the CLI). Retailers listed here stay configured when disabled; the reason is printed by `node run.js --status` and written to the run activity line.

free.description: EUR 0. Runs from GitHub Actions datacenter IPs. No residential proxy, no paid unblocker, no bot-wall evasion. Scraped: the shops that answered plain HTTP from a GitHub runner (verified by the first real run, 2026-10-06: PlayStation Direct, NVIDIA, Mueller, ALTERNATE) and, on trial, the PC shops nobody has tried yet (Proshop, computeruniverse, Caseking). A trial shop gets one canary request per run, rests for hours after a block and never degrades health. Shops behind a bot wall are fed by affiliate product feeds once approved, or stay off.

psdirect.note: SAP Commerce JSON API, 5 KB. Answered a GitHub runner on 2026-10-06 (first real run, 12 of 12 checks ok).

nvidia.note: Search JSON API, 2 KB. No bot wall seen. Answered a GitHub runner on 2026-10-06.

mueller.note: JSON-LD page, no bot wall seen. Answered a GitHub runner on 2026-10-06.

alternate.note: JSON-LD page, no bot wall seen. Answered a GitHub runner on 2026-10-06 (9 pages). Awin feed (11731) is the fallback if the page gets blocked: set prefer to feed.

proshop.note: Trial since 2026-10-07: JSON-LD product page, never checked from a datacenter IP. One canary request per run until it answers, then it is an ordinary shop. A block puts it to rest 6 h, 24 h, 72 h, 7 days (no breaker, no health change). The Awin product feed (18501) replaces the page as soon as FEED_URL_PROSHOP is set.

A block puts it to rest 6 h, 24 h, 72 h, 7 days (no breaker, no health change). The Awin product feed (11355) replaces the page as soon as FEED_URL_COMPUTERUNIVERSE is set.

A block puts it to rest 6 h, 24 h, 72 h, 7 days (no breaker, no health change). The Awin product feed (28817) replaces the page as soon as FEED_URL_CASEKING is set.

amazon.reason: Needs a residential proxy, and the Amazon Associates licence forbids scraping. Use the PA-API once 3 qualifying sales exist.

mediamarkt.reason: Cloudflare (Turnstile). Needs a residential proxy. Its affiliate network is closed to deal channels, so no feed either.

saturn.reason: Same platform as MediaMarkt: Cloudflare, needs a residential proxy, no feed available to deal channels.

galaxus.reason: Akamai Bot Manager, needs a residential proxy. Prices and stock come from the Tradedoubler product feed once approved.

otto.reason: Kasada. Needs a paid browser unblocker (1 to 3 USD per 1,000 requests). Awin feed not requested: OTTO pays deal channels only 1%.

notebooksbilliger.reason: Akamai. Even a residential IP got the error page. Needs a paid browser unblocker.

cyberport.reason: Cloudflare, 403 even from a residential IP. Prices and stock come from the Awin product feed once approved.

expert.reason: Cloudflare, and the price loads client side: nothing to parse from the HTML.

euronics.reason: Price and stock load through JavaScript: nothing to parse from the HTML.

*.reason: Not verified to answer a datacenter IP. Add a rule for it here after a manual test, or give it a product feed.

paid.description: Everything on, with the proxy or unblocker each adapter declares (PROXY_URL or PROXY_API_TEMPLATE). Costs money: see RECON.md for GB and request prices.
